zh: 点 p 被灯 [l, r] 照亮当且仅当 l≤p 且 r≥p；右端点
照亮数 = 左端点 ≤p 的灯数 − 右端点
分别排序 L、R；对每个控制点 p 计算 upper_bound(L, p) − lower_bound(R, p)，端点处也算照亮；按控制点的原输入顺序输出，不要把控制点排序后再输出。
en: Point p is lit by lamp [l, r] exactly when l ≤ p and r ≥ p; any lamp with right end < p also has left end < p.
Lit count = (lamps with left end ≤ p) − (lamps with right end < p); after sorting the left ends and the right ends separately, each control point needs just two binary searches.
Sort L and R separately; for each control point p compute upper_bound(L, p) − lower_bound(R, p), counting endpoints as lit; output in the original order of the control points, not after sorting them.
